## Hyperthermia

Hyperthermia means overheating. Hyperthermia is a potentially fatal condition, most often seen in football during pre-season training during the latter summer months when outside temperatures are hot, accompanied by high humidity. Heat injury can range from mild heat cramps to heat stroke. Unfortunately, a number of athletes have died from heat stroke during training. Heat stroke is completely preventable, though.
